verses.sloka: तदा वृत्रवधं सर्वमखिलेन स लक्ष्मणः ।कथयित्वा नरश्रेष्ठः कथाशेषं प्रचक्रमे ।। ७.८६.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tadā vṛtravadhaṁ sarvamakhilena sa lakṣmaṇaḥ ।kathayitvā naraśreṣṭhaḥ kathāśeṣaṁ pracakrame ।। 7.86.1 ॥

translations.english: Then, Lakshmana, the best among men, having completely narrated the entire story of Vritra's slaying, proceeded to tell the rest of the tale.
translations.hindi: उत्तरकाण्ड का उनहत्तरवॉ सगं समाप्त हुआ । र = सप्ततितमः सग; हते तु लवणे देवाः सेन्द्राः साग्निपुरोगमाः । ऊचुः सुमधुरां वाणीं शत्रुघ्न शत्र तापनम्‌

verses.sloka: ततो हते महावीर्ये वृत्रे देवभयङ्करे ।ब्रह्महत्यावृतः शक्रः सञ्ज्ञां लेभे न वृत्रहा ।। ७.८६.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato hate mahāvīrye vṛtre devabhayaṅkare ।brahmahatyāvṛtaḥ śakraḥ sañjñāṁ lebhe na vṛtrahā ।। 7.86.2 ॥

translations.english: After the mighty Vritra, who was a terror to the gods, was slain, Indra, the slayer of Vritra, became enveloped by the sin of Brahmanicide and did not regain his consciousness.
translations.hindi: हे वत्स ! सोभाग्य ही से तुम्हारी यह जीत हुई है और लव- णासुर मारा गया है। हे पुरुषसिह ! अब्र तुम वर माँगो

verses.sloka: सो ऽन्तमाश्रित्य लोकानां नष्टसञ्ज्ञो विचेतनः ।कालं तत्रावसत्कञ्चिद्वेष्टमान इवोरगः ।। ७.८६.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: so 'ntamāśritya lokānāṁ naṣṭasañjño vicetanaḥ ।kālaṁ tatrāvasatkañcidveṣṭamāna ivoragaḥ ।। 7.86.3 ॥

translations.english: Having lost his senses and consciousness, he (Indra) took refuge at the ends of the worlds and remained there for some time, writhing like a serpent.
translations.hindi: हे महाबाहो ! हम सब अर देने वाले तुम्हारे विजय की इच्छा से यहाँ आए हैं | हम लोगों का दर्शन निष्फल नहीं होता

verses.sloka: अथ नष्टे सहस्राक्षे उद्विग्नमभवज्जगत् ।भूमिश्च ध्वस्तसङ्काशा निःस्नेहा शुष्ककानना ।। ७.८६.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: atha naṣṭe sahasrākṣe udvignamabhavajjagat ।bhūmiśca dhvastasaṅkāśā niḥsnehā śuṣkakānanā ।। 7.86.4 ॥

translations.english: Then, with the disappearance of the thousand-eyed Indra, the world became distressed, and the earth appeared devastated, devoid of moisture, and with dry forests.
translations.hindi: जितेन्द्रिय महाबलवान शत्रुघ्न जी, देवताओं के इन बचर्नों को सुन, सिर झुका और हाथ जोड़ कर, बोले

verses.sloka: निःस्रोतसश्च ते सर्वे तु ह्रदाश्च सरितस्तथा ।सङ्क्षोभश्चैव सत्त्वानामनावृष्टिकृतो ऽभवत् ।। ७.८६.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: niḥsrotasaśca te sarve tu hradāśca saritastathā ।saṅkṣobhaścaiva sattvānāmanāvṛṣṭikṛto 'bhavat ।। 7.86.5 ॥

translations.english: All those lakes and rivers became dried up without streams, and a great agitation among living beings occurred, caused by the drought.
translations.hindi: हे देवताओं ! मुझे आप यह सब से बड़ा वर दें कि, यह देव ताओं की बनाई मनोहर मधुरा पुरी शीघ्र ही धन जन से पूर्ण हो जाय

verses.sloka: क्षीयमाणे तु लोके ऽस्मिन्सम्भ्रान्तमनसः सुराः ।यदुक्तं विष्णुना पूर्वं तं यज्ञं समुपानयन् ।। ७.८६.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣīyamāṇe tu loke 'sminsambhrāntamanasaḥ surāḥ ।yaduktaṁ viṣṇunā pūrvaṁ taṁ yajñaṁ samupānayan ।। 7.86.6 ॥

translations.english: With bewildered minds, the gods performed that sacrifice which Vishnu had previously instructed, as this world was diminishing.
translations.hindi: शत्रुन्नके ये वचन सुन कर, देवताओं ने प्रसन्न हो, उनसे कहा ऐसा ही होगा, यह पुरी बहुत अच्छी तरह शूरसेना सहित बस जायगी अथवा अजेय होगी

verses.sloka: ततः सर्वे सुरगणाः सोपाध्यायाः सहर्षिभिः ।तं देशं समुपाजग्मुर्यत्रेन्द्रो भयमोहितः ।। ७.८६.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ sarve suragaṇāḥ sopādhyāyāḥ saharṣibhiḥ ।taṁ deśaṁ samupājagmuryatrendro bhayamohitaḥ ।। 7.86.7 ॥

translations.english: Then, all the hosts of gods, accompanied by their preceptors and sages, approached that place where Indra was deluded by fear.

verses.sloka: ते तु दृष्ट्वा सहस्राक्षमावृतं ब्रह्महत्यया ।तं पुरस्कृत्य देवेशमश्वमेधमुपाक्रमन् ।। ७.८६.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: te tu dṛṣṭvā sahasrākṣamāvṛtaṁ brahmahatyayā ।taṁ puraskṛtya deveśamaśvamedhamupākraman ।। 7.86.8 ॥

translations.english: Having seen the thousand-eyed Indra enveloped by the sin of Brahmanicide, they honored him and commenced the Ashwamedha sacrifice.
translations.hindi: यह कहू कर महात्मा देदतागण स्वर्गे को चले गए और मद्दा- तेजस्वी शत्रुघ्न जी ने गङ्गातट पर टिक्की हुई अपनी सेना को बुलाया ॥ ७ सा सेना शीघ्रमागच्छच्छुत्वा शत्रुघ्रशासनम्‌ । निवेशनं च. शत्रुघ्न: श्रावणेन समारभत्‌

verses.sloka: ततो ऽश्वमेधः सुमहान्महेन्द्रस्य महात्मनः ।ववृधे ब्रह्महत्ययाः पावनार्थं नरेश्वर ।। ७.८६.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato 'śvamedhaḥ sumahānmahendrasya mahātmanaḥ ।vavṛdhe brahmahatyayāḥ pāvanārthaṁ nareśvara ।। 7.86.9 ॥

translations.english: O king of men, then the very great Ashwamedha sacrifice of the great-souled Mahendra prospered for the purification from the sin of Brahmanicide.

verses.sloka: ततो यज्ञे समाप्ते तु ब्रह्महत्या महात्मनः ।अभिगम्याब्रवीद्वाक्यं क्व मे स्थानं विधास्यथ ।। ७.८६.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: tato yajñe samāpte tu brahmahatyā mahātmanaḥ ।abhigamyābravīdvākyaṁ kva me sthānaṁ vidhāsyatha ।। 7.86.10 ॥

translations.english: When the sacrifice was completed, the personified sin of brahmin-slaughter that clung to the great-souled Indra approached and asked, 'Where will you appoint a dwelling place for me?'
translations.hindi: वह समूचा देश का वेश, धान्य युक्त हो गया, क्योंकि इन्द्र समय पर जल की बषा कर दिआ करते थे । शत्रुघ्न द्वारा शासित उस पुरी के निबासी बीर ओर निरोगी देख पड़ते लगे

verses.sloka: ते तामूचुस्तदा देवास्तुष्टाः प्रीतिसमन्विताः ।चतुर्धा विभजात्मानमात्मनैव दुरासदे ।। ७.८६.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: te tāmūcustadā devāstuṣṭāḥ prītisamanvitāḥ ।caturdhā vibhajātmānamātmanaiva durāsade ।। 7.86.11 ॥

translations.english: Then, the gods, pleased and filled with affection, said to her (Brahmahatya), "O difficult to approach one, divide yourself into four parts by yourself."
translations.hindi: टिप्पणी-आज भो मथुरा प्रान्त के लोग शरीर से हृष्ट पुष्ट आर वीर से पाए जाते हैं । ] ९ ८ र रि अधचन्द्रपतोकाशा यमुनातीरशाभिता । शोभिता गृहयुख्येश्न चत्वरापणवीयकेः । र 2 चातुवण्यममायुक्ता नानावाणिज्यशोभिता

verses.sloka: देवानां भाषितं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्महत्या महात्मनाम् ।सन्निधौ स्थानमन्यत्र वरयामास दुर्वसा ।। ७.८६.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: devānāṁ bhāṣitaṁ śrutvā brahmahatyā mahātmanām ।sannidhau sthānamanyatra varayāmāsa durvasā ।। 7.86.12 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of the great gods, the personified sin of Brahman-killing, named Durvasa, chose a different dwelling place in their presence.
translations.hindi: लवण ने पूवकाल सें जिन विशाल भवनों को ब ग नवाया था उनमें सफेदी करवा और उन्हें चित्रकारी से सजवा कर, शात्रन्न जीं ने सुन्दर बना दिआ । ( रा० )

verses.sloka: एकेनांशेन वत्स्यामि पूर्णोदासु नदीषु वै ।चतुरो वार्षिकान्मासान्दर्पघ्नी कामवारिणी ।। ७.८६.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: ekenāṁśena vatsyāmi pūrṇodāsu nadīṣu vai ।caturo vārṣikānmāsāndarpaghnī kāmavāriṇī ।। 7.86.13 ॥

translations.english: She declared that with one part of herself, she would dwell for four months of the rainy season in full-watered rivers, causing pride to be destroyed and desires to be obstructed.
translations.hindi: बह पुरी स्थान स्थान पर वाटिकाओं और विहार करने योग्य स्थलों से शोभित थी। इनके अतिरिक्त शोभा के योग्य देवताओं ओर मनुष्यां से वह पुरी अत्यन्त शोभायमान देख पड़ती थी

verses.sloka: भूम्यामहं सर्वकालमेकेनांशेन सर्वदा ।वसिष्यामि न सन्देहः सत्येनैतद्ब्रवीमि वः ।। ७.८६.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhūmyāmahaṁ sarvakālamekenāṁśena sarvadā ।vasiṣyāmi na sandehaḥ satyenaitadbravīmi vaḥ ।। 7.86.14 ॥

translations.english: She further stated that with another part, she would always dwell on the earth at all times, declaring this truth to them without a doubt.
translations.hindi: बह पुरी दिव्य रूपा थी तथा अनेक प्रकार की वाणिज्य की जस्तुओं से परिपूर्ण होने के कारण, देश देशान्तर के व्यापारी बहाँ व्यापार करने के लिये आने लगे थे

verses.sloka: यो ऽयमंशस्तृतीयो मे स्त्रीषु यौवनशालिषु ।त्रिरात्रं दर्पपूर्णासु वशिष्ये दर्पघातिनी ।। ७.८६.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: yo 'yamaṁśastṛtīyo me strīṣu yauvanaśāliṣu ।trirātraṁ darpapūrṇāsu vaśiṣye darpaghātinī ।। 7.86.15 ॥

translations.english: She announced that her third part would dwell for three nights in young women full of pride, acting as a destroyer of their arrogance.
translations.hindi: भरत के छोटे भाई शत्र न्न जी, जो स्वयं सब प्रकार से भरे पूरे थे ; उस पुरी को इस प्रकार से भरा पूरा देख, बहुत प्रसन्न हुए

verses.sloka: हन्तारो ब्राह्मणान्ये तु मृषापूर्वमदूषकान् ।तांश्चतुर्थेन भागेन संश्रयिष्ये सुरर्षभाः ।। ७.८६.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: hantāro brāhmaṇānye tu mṛṣāpūrvamadūṣakān ।tāṁścaturthena bhāgena saṁśrayiṣye surarṣabhāḥ ।। 7.86.16 ॥

translations.english: She concluded by stating, "O best of gods, I shall resort with my fourth part to those who kill innocent Brahmins after falsely accusing them."
translations.hindi: तदनन्तर इन्होने सोचा कि, हमें (अयोध्या छोड़े) यह बारहवाँ वर्ष है । अतः अब चल कर, श्रीरामचन्द्र जी के चरणों के दर्शन करने चाहिए

verses.sloka: प्रत्यूचुस्तां ततो देवा यथा वदसि दुर्वसे ।तथा भवतु तत्सर्वं साधयस्व यदीप्सितम् ।। ७.८६.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: pratyūcustāṁ tato devā yathā vadasi durvase ।tathā bhavatu tatsarvaṁ sādhayasva yadīpsitam ।। 7.86.17 ॥

translations.english: Then the gods replied to him, "O sage, as you say, so let it be; accomplish all that is desired."

verses.sloka: ततः प्रीत्या ऽन्विता देवाः सहस्राक्षं ववन्दिरे ।विज्वरः स च पूतात्मा वासवः समपद्यत ।। ७.८६.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prītyā 'nvitā devāḥ sahasrākṣaṁ vavandire ।vijvaraḥ sa ca pūtātmā vāsavaḥ samapadyata ।। 7.86.18 ॥

translations.english: Then the gods, filled with joy, saluted the thousand-eyed Indra, and Indra himself became free from distress and purified in soul.

verses.sloka: प्रशान्तं च जगत्सर्वं सहस्राक्षे प्रतिष्ठिते ।यज्ञं चाद्भुतसङ्काशं तदा शक्रो ऽभ्यपूजयत् ।। ७.८६.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: praśāntaṁ ca jagatsarvaṁ sahasrākṣe pratiṣṭhite ।yajñaṁ cādbhutasaṅkāśaṁ tadā śakro 'bhyapūjayat ।। 7.86.19 ॥

translations.english: And when the thousand-eyed Indra was re-established, the entire world became peaceful, and then Indra worshipped the wondrous sacrifice.

verses.sloka: ईदृशो ह्यश्वमेधस्य प्रसादो रघुनन्दन ।यजस्व सुमहाभाग हयमेधेन पार्थिव ।। ७.८६.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: īdṛśo hyaśvamedhasya prasādo raghunandana ।yajasva sumahābhāga hayamedhena pārthiva ।। 7.86.20 ॥

translations.english: O Rama, such indeed is the efficacy of the Ashwamedha sacrifice; therefore, O greatly fortunate king, perform the horse sacrifice.

verses.sloka: इति लक्ष्मणवाक्यमुत्तमं नृपतिरतीव मनोहरं महात्मा ।परितोषमवाप हृष्टचेता निशमय्येन्द्रसमानविक्रमौजाः ।। ७.८६.२१ ।।
verses.transliteration: iti lakṣmaṇavākyamuttamaṁ nṛpatiratīva manoharaṁ mahātmā ।paritoṣamavāpa hṛṣṭacetā niśamayyendrasamānavikramaujāḥ ।। 7.86.21 ।।

translations.english: Having heard these excellent and exceedingly charming words of Lakshmana, the great-souled king, whose valor and energy were equal to Indra's, felt great satisfaction with a joyful mind. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे षडशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 86 ।। Thus ends the eighty-sixth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
